parentAdmissionRepair.status: locally verified and committed by automatic git-sync
parentAdmissionRepair.mechanism: Existing runGovernedOperation admits each serialized model child before spawn, retains its receipt until exit, forwards lineage to the PG-forbidden child, cancels failed starts and settles a bound successful receipt's measured peak RSS.
parentAdmissionRepair.initialMemoryDemand: Pinned artifact bytes, explicitly an estimate; measured peak RSS is recorded at settlement.
parentAdmissionRepair.startupIsolation: Governor setup is lazy and the admitting parent uses a dedicated client; model children keep PAPERCUSP_FORBID_REAL_PG=1.

focusedVerification.provenance: Local run overlapped HEAD 96a73d3d41 to 8a33b9bffc; both committed trees were identical. New regression was untracked during the run. Imported uncommitted source movement was not measured.

parentAdmissionRepair.futureRecipeRequirement: New full runs must pin the repaired source and permit the parent admission client to access Postgres. Historical v4 and diagnostic receipts keep their original source fingerprints.

poolIdleRepair.status: synthetic causal class verified; real-model diagnostic in progress
poolIdleRepair.pairedControl: Sequential pooled requests pass a blocked 10.5-second response-completion pause; the original concurrent batch topology reproduces ECONNRESET. The canonical guard joins the failed send, server idle timeout and client error by TCP port.
poolIdleRepair.historicalLimit: The original v4 closing actor and source of its nine-second gap were not observed. This reproduces and repairs the failure class; it does not attribute that historical gap to disk or establish its closing actor.
poolIdleRepair.ruledOut: Both the installed and actual built-in Undici sources select native timers for keep-alive; their fast timer clock is not the cause established by this test.
poolIdleRepair.repair: The collector awaits Promise-valued sample retention and the CLI uses fs.promises.appendFile, retaining evidence before advancing while allowing native idle socket callbacks to progress. Pooling, request counts, server timeouts and retry policy are unchanged.
